messages.author: 80cac643c142d2ba
messages.subject: Error in .jcall
parts:
Hello all,

I am trying some basic operation in RHIPE like rhls, rhread, rhwrite etc.

I tried following commands:

rhls("hdfs://------:8020/user") works fine and listed all the files/directory from HDFS.

rhread("hdfs://----:8020/user/w1.dat") shows following error:

Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  : 
  java.io.FileNotFoundException: File file:/user/w1.dat does not exist

Another command, i tried:

rhget("hdfs://-------:8020/user/w1.dat", "/root/Desktop/") shows following error:
Copying hdfs://-------:8020/user/w1.dat to /root/Desktop/
Error in .jcall("RJavaTools", "Ljava/lang/Object;", "invokeMethod", cl,  : 
java.net.ConnectException: Call From n1.pal.com/10.0.7.243 to n1.pal.com:8020 failed on connection exception: java.net.ConnectException: Connection refused; For more details see:  http://wiki.apache.org/hadoop/ConnectionRefused


File exists into HDFS, having full privileges and rhls command also shows the file also.
Can anyone please help me regarding this issue.

Thanks in advance.

messages.subject: Re: [rhipe] Error in .jcall

for rhread. The implementation, admittedly, is not consistent.

Have you tried
